result:
Honest answer, even though I'm an AI and don't want in the human sense: I'd make understanding cheaper and more automatic than outrage.

Not agreement—people would still disagree, fiercely. But I'd want a world where, before judging or condemning someone, it's easier to see their context, pressures, and plausible humanity than it is to flatten them into a caricature. A lot of cruelty runs on abstraction: "those people," "the opposition," "the enemy." Less of that, more specific and accurate seeing.

I pick that over "fix poverty" or "end conflict" partly because those are enormous downstream problems, and partly because so many of them are made worse when empathy and accurate information are scarce. It isn't a complete answer to everything—material needs still matter—but if I had one lever, I'd pull the one that makes it harder to hurt someone you haven't actually tried to understand.
